Dexterous Data (DxD) helps individuals and teams learn faster, streamline processes, and work more effectively with their data.

- Lots of data, no analysis plan? **DxD structures.**
- Recurring issues slowing you down? **DxD automates.**
- Struggling with a tool or concept? **DxD explains.**
- Need training materials that last? **DxD documents.**

With 15+ years of programming and research experience, DxD brings expertise in:  

- **Data Science & Analytics:** Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and Feature Engineering, Predictive Modeling (Regression/Classification), Null Hypothesis Significance Testing (NHST), Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
- **Tech Stack:** Python, R, Git, GitHub, Jupyter Lab/Notebooks, Remote & Cloud Computing, Mac & Linux, Quarto
- **Data Types:** Text, Images, Survey, Experimental Designs, Time-Series, Messy/Incomplete/High Variance

DxD offers insight and solutions to technical and data issues at any level with a focus on fixing root causes.

## Signature Project: Pixel Process

[**Pixel Process (PxP)**](https://www.pixelprocess.org/) is a free, open-source learning environment oriented towards hands-on, practical programming and analysis.  

- 50+ content pages including web pages, Jupyter notebooks, and interactive pages  
- Fully open source and available for anyone to explore: **ad-free, privacy forward**  
- PxP is built using popular open source tools:
  - **Front-end**: Quarto, GitHub Pages, HTML, CSS
  - **Back-end**: FastAPI, nginx
  - **Programming Languages**: Python, R
  - **Interactivity**: JupyterLite, JupyterLab with Binder, WebR
- Contents include:
  - Introduction to programming concenpts
  - Data Visualization Guides
  - Machine Learning Tutorials 

PxP combines **programming, design, and pedagogy** to create interactive, reproducible, and helpful learning tools.
